lifetime: Queue4 serializes entry. Payloads remain readable for their source-bound length and do not overlap the copied destination. No new callback code or data pointer is published. The experiment stays resident for the guarded PLAY interval; unload and callback quiescence are not claimed.
source_effect: 0x0124b110 is not omitted: its only byte-store effect is already owned by prepare_source for0x0101. Other callers keep the original helper retained.
limits: Only preparation and its actual integrated pair are claimed. Router, dispatcher, action/followup banks, rendering, storage, full playback browsing, capture/save and hardware remain retained or unqualified. The stock0x011e duplicate copy becomes one copy under the nonoverlapping queue-payload contract.
